summary: Yemeni Houthi forces launched ballistic missile strikes against a Saudi military vessel and accompanying boats off Al-Mukha, causing fires and sinkings, while Iran announced a shift from defensive to fully offensive policy and threatened retaliation against U.S. naval blockade. Simultaneously, the IDF conducted precise aerial strikes in Khan Younis and Nuseirat, eliminating a Palestinian Islamic Jihad and a Hamas operative advancing attacks. In Iraq, drones targeted the office of Kurdish Prime Minister Masrour Barzani, coinciding with revelations of a secret Trump-IRGC backchannel via the Kurdish presidency.
key_points: Houthi ballistic missiles hit Saudi military vessel and four boats off Al-Mukha, Red Sea, setting ship ablaze and sinking several boats. (Source: @SharghDaily/178505)
Houthi forces also struck a Saudi weapons depot at Camp Sahn al-Jan in Marib with drones, causing fire. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385264)
IDF carried out two strikes in Gaza within an hour, killing a PIJ operative in Khan Younis and a Hamas operative in Nuseirat. (Source: @manniefabian/58980)
Senior Iranian official declared policy shift from defensive to fully offensive, refusing to wait indefinitely for U.S. naval blockade. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385269)
At least two drones targeted the office of Kurdistan Region PM Masrour Barzani in Erbil, Iraq. (Source: @asafroz/52512)
Israeli Defense Minister Katz ordered IDF to present plan within two weeks to transfer West Bank civil enforcement to Israel Police. (Source: @yediotnews25/134012)
Turkish President Erdogan stated Turkey seeks peace but will not hesitate to fight if attacked with war intentions. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94174)
Saudi Arabia removed references to "Zionist enemy," "Israeli occupation," and Muslim claims to Jerusalem from textbooks. (Source: @kianmeli1/90899)

sections.executive_summary: Yemeni Houthi forces launched ballistic missile strikes against a Saudi military vessel and accompanying boats off Al-Mukha, causing fires and sinkings, while Iran announced a shift from defensive to fully offensive policy and threatened retaliation against U.S. naval blockade. Simultaneously, the IDF conducted precise aerial strikes in Khan Younis and Nuseirat, eliminating a Palestinian Islamic Jihad and a Hamas operative advancing attacks. In Iraq, drones targeted the office of Kurdish Prime Minister Masrour Barzani, coinciding with revelations of a secret Trump-IRGC backchannel via the Kurdish presidency.

points: A senior Iranian official declared Iran has decided to shift its policy from defensive to fully offensive and will not wait indefinitely for the U.S. naval blockade to end, signaling a major strategic escalation. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385269)

Iran's Army Chief Amir Hatami announced a bounty of $30,000 (approx. 5 billion tomans) for anyone who kills or captures an American and hands them to Army units, with double rewards for women and double weapon value reimbursement. (Source: @VahidOnline/77898)

Former U.S. President Trump claimed a secret communication channel exists with the IRGC and that he speaks directly with IRGC officials in Iran, suggesting covert diplomacy amid tensions. (Source: @SharghDaily/178498)

Two senior IRGC officials told the New York Times that during the ceasefire, Iranian generals held secret discussions with militia commanders on expanding the war and increasing costs for the U.S., including video conferences with Hezbollah, Houthis, and pro-Iran militias. (Source: @asafroz/52508)

The Iranian Parliament approved a 33-article "Countering Infiltration" bill imposing severe penalties for unauthorized foreign contacts, scholarships, media interviews, and cultural exchanges, with prison terms up to 5 years and professional bans. (Source: @shin_persian/8990)

Multiple petrol stations in Tehran districts including Niavaran, Tajrish, Vali Asr, and Shariati reportedly closed due to fuel shortages, indicating domestic supply strain. (Source: @shin_persian/8978)
Former U.S. Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene alleged that using a nuclear bomb against Iran was discussed in Trump's meetings, calling it a diabolical plan that must be stopped. (Source: @kianmeli1/90902)

The IDF confirmed two precise aerial strikes in Gaza within an hour, targeting a Palestinian Islamic Jihad operative in Khan Younis and a Hamas operative in Nuseirat who were advancing terror attacks, according to military statements. (Source: @manniefabian/58980)

Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz directed the IDF to submit within two weeks a plan to transfer civil enforcement responsibilities in the West Bank (Judea and Samaria) to the Israel Police. (Source: @yediotnews25/134012)
A security source indicated Israel is preparing for scenarios of rocket fire toward northern communities and expanding military activity in Lebanon in the coming days. (Source: @pkpoi/143620)
Reports indicate warplanes flying toward Lebanon at maximum alert, suggesting heightened aerial readiness on Israel's northern front. (Source: @redlinkleb/37041)
Additional reports show warplanes flying toward the south (likely southern Lebanon/Israel border) at maximum alert, reinforcing northern tension. (Source: @redlinkleb/37057)
Former President Trump stated he thinks it best to stay out of Israeli elections but may endorse someone, while not signaling a preferred candidate. (Source: @amitsegal/63934)
Netanyahu, Kushner, and the Peace Council CEO reportedly met to discuss a plan for Gaza, indicating ongoing diplomatic efforts. (Source: @amitsegal/63931)

The IDF conducted two strikes in the Gaza Strip within an hour, eliminating a Palestinian Islamic Jihad operative in Khan Younis (southern Gaza) and a Hamas operative in Nuseirat (central Gaza) who were advancing attacks. (Source: @manniefabian/58980)
Palestinian media reported the strike in Nuseirat injured several people, while the IDF stated the terrorists were struck in precise aerial strikes to remove the threat. (Source: @manniefabian/58979)
IDF separately confirmed strikes in Khan Younis and Nuseirat targeting two terrorists from Islamic Jihad and Hamas respectively. (Source: @inon_yttach/9866)

Defense Minister Israel Katz ordered the IDF to formulate a plan within two weeks to transfer civil enforcement activity in the West Bank to Israel Police responsibility. (Source: @yediotnews25/134012)
No additional specific Gaza or West Bank operational details were provided in the source messages beyond these strikes and policy announcement.
Warplanes were reported flying toward Lebanon at maximum alert, indicating heightened Israeli aerial activity or readiness on the northern border. (Source: @redlinkleb/37041)
A security source stated Israel is preparing for scenarios of rocket fire toward northern communities and expanding military activity in Lebanon in the coming days. (Source: @pkpoi/143620)

Turkish President Erdogan declared Turkey is not seeking war with Israel but emphasized that if attacked with war intentions, Turkey will not hesitate to fight and will not flee. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94174)
No specific Lebanese military actions, Hezbollah operations, or border incidents were detailed in the provided messages beyond Israeli readiness.
At least two drones were launched toward the office of Masrour Barzani, Prime Minister of the Kurdistan Region in northern Iraq (Erbil), per Reuters reports. (Source: @asafroz/52512)
Iraqi Counter-Terrorism Unit raided a home in Nasiriyah, Dhi Qar province, and arrested a leader of the Al-Nujaba Movement militia affiliated with Akram al-Kaabi. (Source: @shin_persian/8991)

Senior IRGC Quds Force commanders held video conferences with commanders of Hezbollah, Houthis, and pro-Iran militias in Iraq and elsewhere to discuss expanding the war and increasing costs for the U.S. (Source: @asafroz/52508)

Nechirvan Barzani, President of the Kurdistan Region, reportedly serves as a direct backchannel between Trump and the IRGC commander, linking the drone strike to broader diplomatic dynamics. (Source: @asafroz/52512)

Yemeni Houthi forces fired several ballistic missiles at a Saudi military vessel carrying forces and equipment, plus four accompanying military boats, in the Red Sea off Al-Mukha coast, hitting the ship directly and causing it to catch fire completely; some boats sank, others burned. (Source: @SharghDaily/178505)
Houthi forces also targeted a Saudi weapons depot at Camp Sahn al-Jan in Marib province with several drones, achieving a precise hit that ignited a major fire. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385264)
An emergency alert was issued in the Jazan region of Saudi Arabia at 1257Z, indicating imminent threat perception. (Source: @shin_persian/8976)

Oman's Sultan Haitham bin Tariq visited Abu Dhabi and met UAE President Mohammed bin Zayed to discuss bilateral, regional, and international issues and ways to achieve security and stability. (Source: @SharghDaily/178507)

Saudi Arabia removed the phrases "Zionist enemy," "Israeli occupation," and "Muslims will never give up Jerusalem" from its textbooks, signaling a shift in official narrative. (Source: @kianmeli1/90899)
Houthi missile attacks on hostile ships in the Bab al-Mandab strait were also reported, including a vessel named "Amir Khan." (Source: @naya_foriraq/87954, @rasedal3ado138e/385259)

key_developments: Houthi ballistic missile salvo struck Saudi military vessel and four escort boats off Al-Mukha, Red Sea, igniting the ship and sinking several boats, per Yemeni armed forces spokesperson Yahya Saree. (Source: @SharghDaily/178505)
Houthi drones precisely hit a Saudi weapons depot at Camp Sahn al-Jan in Marib province, causing a major fire, according to Yemeni military spokesman. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385264)

IDF executed two precise aerial strikes in Gaza within an hour, eliminating a Palestinian Islamic Jihad operative in Khan Younis and a Hamas operative in Nuseirat who were advancing attacks. (Source: @manniefabian/58980)
A senior Iranian official announced a strategic shift from defensive to fully offensive posture, declaring Iran will not indefinitely tolerate U.S. naval blockade. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385269)

At least two unmanned aerial vehicles targeted the Erbil office of Kurdistan Region Prime Minister Masrour Barzani, amid reports his uncle Nechirvan Barzani mediates between Trump and IRGC. (Source: @asafroz/52512)

Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz directed the IDF to formulate within two weeks a plan transferring civil enforcement responsibilities in the West Bank to Israel Police. (Source: @yediotnews25/134012)
Saudi Arabia officially excised the terms "Zionist enemy," "Israeli occupation," and assertions that Muslims will never relinquish Jerusalem from its educational curricula. (Source: @kianmeli1/90899)
sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous Houthi escalation in the Red Sea and Iran's declared offensive shift indicate a coordinated axis strategy to pressure Saudi Arabia and challenge U.S. maritime presence. The IDF's targeted killings in Gaza suggest continued high-tempo counterterrorism operations, while the drone strike on Erbil highlights vulnerability of Kurdish leadership amid U.S.-Iran backchannel talks. Israel's preparation for northern escalation and West Bank administrative overhaul point to a multi-front contingency posture. The Saudi textbook changes reflect a deeper normalization trajectory that could provoke domestic and regional backlash.
sections.regional_response: Oman's diplomatic engagement with the UAE signals Gulf coordination on de-escalation, yet Houthi attacks persist. Turkey's Erdogan balances rhetoric between peace and deterrence toward Israel. Iraq's arrest of an Al-Nujaba
